# 0013: Attribute-Declared Secret Fields

Let an author mark which Kubernetes Secret a field belongs in with a CUE attribute, so the field itself holds only the value the deployer supplies.

**Accepted** 2026-08-14 · ready to implement · 3 of 9 tasks shipped · breaking
